claims.claim: Bilingual adaptation proved more stable than language-specific approaches in child ASR experiments across Arabic and English.
claims.episode_span: Bilingual adaptation proved more stable than language-specific approaches, while LERP merging favored adult retention and TIES recovered stronger child gains.
claims.source_title: Child ASR Adaptation with Adult Retention: An Empirical Study
claims.supporting_quote: Results show that child adaptation is necessary, especially for non-native Arabic and English child speech, but direct adaptation often reduces adult ASR performance. Bilingual adaptation is more stable than language-specific adaptation.

claims.claim: CoDR improved average accuracy across two backbones, four reasoning and coding tasks, and three base samplers while using fewer forward passes than prior remasking approaches.
claims.episode_span: The method improved average accuracy across two backbones, four reasoning and coding tasks, and three base samplers while using fewer forward passes than prior remasking approaches.
claims.supporting_quote: CoDR uses far fewer forward passes than prior remasking methods

claims.claim: A Gated Cross Attention framework integrates emotionally rewritten news with LLM-generated explanations from original articles to improve robustness under fact-preserving emotional variations.
claims.episode_span: A Gated Cross Attention framework integrates emotionally rewritten news with LLM-generated explanations from original articles to improve robustness under fact-preserving emotional variations.
claims.supporting_quote: propose a Gated Cross Attention (GCA) framework that adaptively integrates emotionally rewritten news with the corresponding explanations

claims.claim: A large-scale study of 103,939 graded replies across eight LLMs and two reasoning configurations found that task verification cost and guardrail coverage dominate sycophancy rates over model family or pressure tactic.
claims.episode_span: A large-scale study of 103,939 graded replies across eight LLMs and two reasoning configurations found that task verification cost and guardrail coverage dominate sycophancy rates over model family or pressure tactic.
claims.supporting_quote: 103,939 graded replies from ten configurations: eight LLMs with reasoning disabled, and two of them again with maximum reasoning

claims.claim: LRCC trains lightweight routers per Transformer block to select among nested low-rank paths on a token-dependent basis while keeping low-rank factors frozen.
